title: 27 October 2015: Ringo Starr live at Heinz Hall, Pittsburgh
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Heinz Hall in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA, on 27 October 2015.

It was the 36th show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

What a great Night I had in Pittsburgh peace and love to everybody who came to the show ?????????z

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) October 28, 2015

Starr returned to Heinz Hall on 19 September 2018.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
